== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The early bonus is specifically +3 when drawn for destiny, if an AT-AT or AT-ST is on table. Later says destiny +3 while a walker is on table, without the draw-only clause. The separately Sense-immune take and the opponent's top-card/2 Force loss alternatives are preserved. The exact wording is preserved without asserting how any unnamed effect checks that value.
